notes: macOS releases: Sparkle tools now come from Sparkle's own pinned release. Homebrew disabled the sparkle cask on 2026-09-01, so every macOS release workflow generated by 0.1.0 fails at 'Install Sparkle' — delete .github/workflows/launchpad-<App>-macos.yml and run `launchpad apply` to regenerate it.
Licensing: `launchpad license <key>` activates the key (0.1.0 discarded it and reported no licence). A licence never lapses because the server was unreachable.

Native Android (Kotlin/Java, Gradle) ships: release APK + AAB on GitHub Actions, Firebase App Distribution, proven on a real app. React Native and Expo pipelines are generated; their iOS lanes have not yet been run on a real runner.
Mission Control: a 'Needs you' strip above everything — every credential, cost, irreversible act and store gate, with one action each — and a cost ledger where every number is a decision's own chip.
`launchpad secret set <name>` stores a credential (hidden prompt or piped file) on every vault backend. `launchpad needs` lists what is waiting on you.

Forty-six edge cases now handled without a stack trace: no git, no remote, GitLab/Bitbucket, master/develop, running from a subdirectory, a hand-edited state.yml, a missing config field, Ctrl-C mid-apply.
